scope: Read-only contract recommendation; implementation has not been independently tested in this report.

recommendedContract.identity: Canonical lowercase stable UUID targeting exactly one existing object; no object replacement or array action.
recommendedContract.values: Nonempty exact record containing name and/or color; strings only. No null, reset, primitive, transforms, visibility, material, hierarchy or unknown keys.
recommendedContract.name: Existing schema: 1–256 Unicode codepoints. Preserve exact author string, including whitespace; no trim or normalization.
recommendedContract.color: Existing schema # followed by six hexadecimal digits; case retained and a case change is explicit author intent.
recommendedContract.noop: Decoded string equality preserves prior escaped string token. Native/bridge original bytes plus []; pure authoring refuses unchanged intent and no approval is created.
recommendedContract.paths: Actual net changes, fixed logical order name then color at the existing object index.
recommendedContract.atomic: Validate complete original and final scene, including 128 KiB UTF-8 budget, before exposing any candidate.
recommendedContract.rawText: Only selected name/color string value tokens may change. All key tokens, number tokens, other string tokens, trivia, BOM/CRLF, object ordering and stable UUID bytes remain exact.
recommendedContract.provenance: Independent optional capability and separate private proposal brand; snapshot exact shared five-field source DTO before await, bind all proposal values and selected object UUID, repeat native patch before applying.
recommendedContract.authority: Reuse shared in-memory application guards; keep ordinary Save preconditions/disk cache/baseline/cursor behavior. Existing read-only preview remains three-field source API and never receives applyDraft.
recommendedContract.capabilityFailure: Only new property entry is unavailable; existing preview and transform/object/environment authoring remain usable.

meaningfulChecks: Escaped name/color keys and values, quotes/backslashes/non-BMP names, BOM and CRLF with raw other objects/environment and numeric exponents preserved.
Net noop and explicit color case-only intent; 256 vs 257 Unicode codepoints; color/null/unknown UUID/extra-field refusal.
Name+color atomic final budget including shrink+growth and original invalid source refusal.
Four proposal brands pairwise isolation and cloned proposal refusal.
All three shared application digest awaits retain owner/path/token/content/load/document/baseline/version guards; no Save/network/render/tool call.
Silent object selection or raw string mutation after review revokes approval; late completion cannot mutate replacement editor.
Final source/history/author/tool/atlas baseline preservation; native/WASM parity on actual frozen core.
